# netcup_server_state (Action)

Changes the power state of a netcup server once (SCP REST API), e.g. a restart with `state = "ON"` and `state_option = "RESET"`. Use `power_state` of `netcup_server_settings` for a lasting state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "netcup_server_state" "example" {
  config {
    server_id    = 12345
    state        = "ON"
    state_option = "RESET"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.
- `state` (String) `ON`, `OFF` or `SUSPENDED`.

### Optional

- `state_option` (String) `POWERCYCLE` or `RESET` for `ON`, `POWEROFF` for `OFF`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `invoke` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
